title: Similar submodules of projective modules
summary: We introduce a similarity relation between submodules of a module $M$ over a ring $R$, extending the classical notion of similarity for right ideals. Focusing on (faithfully) projective modules, we establish a sharp lower bound for the number of maximal submodules: if $N$ is a maximal submodule of $M$, then either $N$ is fully invariant or $N$ is similar to at least $1+|S|$ distinct maximal submodules, where $S$ is the eigenring of $N$; in particular, $|{\rm Max}(M)|\geq 1+|S|\geq 3$ in the latter case.
